# Completion Report: Work Order 3 — Scopes & Aliases

## Summary of Completed Work

Implemented and verified the scope and alias routing system in [`internal/core/config`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config):

1. **Declared Scopes Configuration ([`scopes.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L16-L108))**:
   - Defined [`ScopeConfig`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L53-L58) containing `Topics`, `Externals`, and `Procedures`.
   - Defined [`DeclaredScope`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L16-L24) supporting YAML unmarshaling for `name`, `keywords`, `tool_names`/`toolNames`, `commands`, and `description`.
   - Implemented [`LoadScopeConfig`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L60-L108) to read from `config.yaml` under the `scopes:` key, safely returning an empty config if the file or key is missing.

2. **Derived Module Scopes ([`scopes.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L110-L342))**:
   - Defined [`ModuleScope`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L110-L116) (`Name`, `Kind`, `PathGlobs`, `Symbols`).
   - Implemented [`DeriveModuleScopes`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L246-L342) to roll file path anchors up to the nearest parent directory (rolling up if $\le 2$ files in the directory), normalizing paths relative to `internal/`, `cmd/`, or root, and returning deduplicated, sorted scopes.

3. **Alias Resolution ([`scopes.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L344-L517))**:
   - Defined [`AliasMap`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L344-L349).
   - Implemented [`BuildAliasMap`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L473-L517) to process op logs and map `OpSplit` sources to `new_dossiers`.
   - Implemented [`Resolve`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L418-L444) with cycle detection and a max depth of 10.

4. **Scope Resolver ([`scopes.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L519-L799))**:
   - Defined [`ScopeResolver`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L519-L525) and [`NewScopeResolver`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L527-L539).
   - Implemented [`ResolveScope`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L546-L718) prioritising: (1) aliases, (2) module path prefix/symbol match, (3) keyword match against declared topics, externals, and procedures.
   - Implemented [`AllScopes`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L720-L765) and [`ScopeKind`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L767-L798).

5. **Test Suite ([`scopes_test.go`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes_test.go))**:
   - Validated YAML parsing and fallback behavior (`TestLoadScopeConfig_SampleYAML`, `TestLoadScopeConfig_MissingScopesKey`).
   - Validated anchor rollups and naming (`TestDeriveModuleScopes_RollupAndNaming`).
   - Validated alias mapping from split ops and multi-hop chain/cycle resolution (`TestBuildAliasMap_SplitOps`, `TestAliasMap_ResolveChainAndCycle`).
   - Validated scope resolution ordering, scoring, and listing (`TestScopeResolver_ResolveScope`, `TestScopeResolver_AllScopesAndScopeKind`).
